title: Desk Guidance: Remote-Disconnect Meter Relief on Reinstated Security Deposits
content:
A Security Deposits deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis on an account fitted with a remote-disconnect meter carries a remote-meter relief on its reinstatement multiple.

## Guidance

The remote-meter relief is the long remote-meter relief of **0.05** when the reinstated account has a remote-disconnect meter and was connected at least twelve months before today, the short remote-meter relief of **0.02** when it has a remote-disconnect meter and was connected fewer than twelve months before today, and nothing otherwise. The remote-meter relief is taken off the reinstatement multiple. The reinstatement multiple is never below **1.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

The meter type and the connect date are those on the reinstated account's Electric Service by Rate Schedule record; a remote-disconnect meter is the AMI meter type with remote disconnect. Months connected are whole months from the connect date to today.

## Input, judgement, output

| Remote-disconnect meter on the reinstated account | Whole months connected before today | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 0.05 |
| yes | fewer than 12 | 0.02 |
| no | any | nothing |

At exactly twelve whole months the long relief applies; at eleven, the short relief.
